name: git-bug
description: git-bug — bug tracker embedded in git CLI. Distributed bug tracking inside your git repos.

install_steps: curl -LO https://github.com/MichaelMure/git-bug/releases/latest/download/git-bug-linux-amd64.tar.gz && tar xzf git-bug-linux-amd64.tar.gz && sudo mv git-bug /usr/local/bin/ && rm git-bug-linux-amd64.tar.gz
